skill.summary: Enforce Kubernetes namespace governance with quota, RBAC, network policy, and lifecycle audits

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the namespace-governance skill — a toolkit for auditing and enforcing Kubernetes namespace policies.

- Provides the audit command to check all namespaces for policy compliance (ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges, NetworkPolicies, RBAC, label compliance, abandoned namespaces).
- Offers recommended remediation steps and policy manifest templates.
- Includes a quota command to analyze namespace usage and recommend appropriate resource quotas.
- Produces concise, actionable audit reports summarizing violations and needed actions.
